newsitem.title: USA: Aura Systems named in lawsuit -- lawyers.
newsitem.headline: Aura Systems named in lawsuit -- lawyers.

text.p: Aura Systems Inc and its executives were named in a lawsuit filed in the U.S. District Court for the Central District of California on behalf of purchasers of the company's stock, plaintiff's lawyers said.

The lawsuit, which is seeking class action status is on behalf of shareholders who bought the stock between January 18, 1995 and April 25, 1997, the law firms of Schatz & Nobel Pc and Weiss & Yourman said in a joint statement.
Aura Systems was not immediately available for comment.

The complaint alleges that Aura executives made misrepresentations about the company's revenues and earnings in various public filings and failure to make disclosures about certain fund raising under a Regulation S sale, the lawyers said.
